hashes.phash: decode grayscale, resize 32x32 INTER_AREA, float32 DCT, top-left 8x8, threshold all 64 coefficients by median of the 63 non-DC coefficients, pack row-major to uint64
hashes.candidate_scope: different visit_id only; minimum distance over all variant pairs
hashes.candidate_search: four 16-bit partitions with distance<=1 neighbor lookup followed by exact uint64 bit_count; total distance<=6 guarantees retrieval by pigeonhole

review.packet_content: RGB pair, role/visit/video/frame IDs, payload hashes, closest variants and pHash distance only
review.admission: all candidate edges receive two DISTINCT_CAPTURE labels with no disagreement
review.hold: any SAME_CAPTURE, UNKNOWN, disagreement, missing review, payload/hash mismatch, or incomplete candidate search
